## Francis Bacon on knowledge

Francis Bacon (1561–1626) approaches knowledge within empiricism. Idols of the tribe, cave, marketplace, and theatre distort natural inquiry; method must correct them. Induction should proceed by controlled elimination and tables of presence/absence, not hasty generalization. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets knowledge most directly—useful for searches such as “francis bacon quotes on knowledge.”
